title: Required, minlength, maxlength, min, max, pattern
learningObjectives: Use required, minlength, maxlength, min, max, pattern accessibly and safely.

understand.concept: Constraint attributes guide input but can be bypassed. Validate on a trusted server.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct form structure improves usability, accessibility and data safety.
understand.analogy: Think of a well-labelled application form.
understand.analogyLimit: Browser checks alone do not make submitted data trustworthy; the server must validate it.

explain.narrative: Constraint attributes guide input but can be bypassed. Validate on a trusted server.

examples.code: <label for="code">Code</label><input id="code" name="code" required minlength="4" maxlength="8">
examples.explanation: Inspect labels, types and validation for each control.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the form controls and provides native behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Modify the example and operate every control using the keyboard.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible registration form that respects privacy.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Required, minlength, maxlength, min, max, pattern</title></head><body>
<label for="code">Code</label><input id="code" name="code" required minlength="4" maxlength="8">
</body></html>
